singapore/marina-bay.name: Marina Bay Sands, Merlion and the waterfront
singapore/marina-bay.description: The skyline icon, the Merlion statue and a walk around the bay at night.
singapore/marina-bay.details: Marina Bay has the Marina Bay Sands hotel with its rooftop SkyPark, the Merlion, the Helix Bridge and the Spectra light show nightly at 8pm and 9pm. Walk the bayfront at sunset. The ArtScience Museum is close.

singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.name: Gardens by the Bay and Supertree Grove
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.description: Giant tree-shaped vertical gardens and two cooled conservatories, with an evening light show.
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.details: Gardens by the Bay has the Supertree Grove with its elevated walkway, the Flower Dome and the Cloud Forest. The Garden Rhapsody light show runs at 7:45pm and 8:45pm. Visit in the late afternoon to combine daylight and the show. The outdoor garden is free.

singapore/chinatown-hawker.name: Chinatown, temples and hawker food
singapore/chinatown-hawker.description: Heritage shophouses, the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple and the Maxwell and Chinatown Complex food centres.
singapore/chinatown-hawker.details: Chinatown has the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Sri Mariamman Hindu temple and Chinatown Complex Food Centre, where you can eat chicken rice and char kway teow for a few dollars. The Michelin-recognised hawker stalls queue early. Go hungry.

singapore/little-india-kampong-glam.name: Little India and Kampong Glam
singapore/little-india-kampong-glam.description: Colourful temples and spice shops, then the Sultan Mosque and Arab Street cafes.
singapore/little-india-kampong-glam.details: Little India has the Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple, flower garlands and Tekka Centre for curry. Nearby Kampong Glam has the golden-domed Sultan Mosque, Haji Lane boutiques and Middle Eastern restaurants. Little India is lively after dark.

singapore/sentosa.name: Sentosa Island
singapore/sentosa.description: A resort island with beaches, theme parks, cable cars and an aquarium.
singapore/sentosa.details: Sentosa has Universal Studios, the S.E.A. Aquarium, Siloso Beach and the Skyline Luge. It is reached by cable car, monorail or a walk across the boardwalk from VivoCity. Allow a full day, and bring sun protection.

singapore/pulau-ubin.name: Pulau Ubin by bike
singapore/pulau-ubin.description: A rustic island with kampong life, mangroves and the Chek Jawa wetlands, a bumboat ride away.
singapore/pulau-ubin.details: Pulau Ubin is a granite island where Singapore used to live. Bumboats leave Changi Point Ferry Terminal when full. Rent a bike on arrival, and ride to the Chek Jawa boardwalk. There are few facilities, so bring water.

singapore/zoo-night-safari.name: Singapore Zoo and Night Safari
singapore/zoo-night-safari.description: An open-concept zoo, and the world first nocturnal zoo.
singapore/zoo-night-safari.details: The Singapore Zoo has orangutans at breakfast and a rainforest setting. The Night Safari opens after dusk with trams through animal habitats and walking trails. The River Wonders and Bird Paradise parks are in the same area. Mosquito repellent is useful.

singapore/botanic-gardens.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens and Orchard Road
singapore/botanic-gardens.description: A UNESCO tropical garden with an orchid collection, and the famous shopping street.
singapore/botanic-gardens.details: The Botanic Gardens have the National Orchid Garden and the Rainforest, and are free to enter. Orchard Road is lined with malls and food courts. Both are easy by MRT. Stay in air-conditioning in the midday heat.
